Turf Laying · The Hills Shire

Nothing transforms a yard faster than a fresh lawn. Hill Shire Landscaping supplies and lays quality turf across The Hills Shire — whether you’re replacing a tired, patchy lawn or laying new grass over a bare block after a build or landscaping job.

The secret to turf that takes is all in the preparation. We clear the old surface, grade and level the ground, add and rake a quality underlay, then lay fresh turf tight with staggered joins so it knits together into an even, healthy lawn. Pick the right grass for your block — sun, shade, kids, pets — and we’ll set it up to thrive.

Turf Laying FAQs
props.html:
Good to know

Turf Laying FAQs

What’s the best turf for The Hills Shire?
It depends on your yard — some varieties handle shade better, others are tougher for kids and pets or greener through winter. We’ll match a variety to your block and how you’ll use it.
How do I look after new turf?
The first few weeks matter most — keep it well watered so the roots take, and hold off heavy use. We give you simple aftercare guidance when we finish, and can handle ongoing mowing if you like.
Do I need to prepare the ground first?
No — we handle the lot: clearing the old surface, levelling, laying underlay and laying the turf. Good prep is exactly why our lawns take and last.
